_notes.scan_notes: 21-25 keV, continuous tomography mode, 1025 projections; reconstructed with TomoPy (per published Methods). Objective/pixel size not yet confirmed per species (paper reports 5x/1.27um, 10x/0.64um, or 40x/0.1625um across the full 86-species dataset, not broken out individually).
_notes.species_list_check: Not found in Table S1 (the 86-species list) of Theroux-Rancourt et al. 2021, despite contributor confirming this dataset was 'used in' that paper. 10x/0.64um objective assumed to match the other 3 same-proposal specimens (Calamagrostis, Koelreuteria, Pleopeltis), but not independently verified against a table row like those three.
_notes.scanner: X-ray μCT beamline (8.3.2), 10× objective, at the Advanced Light Source, Lawrence Berkeley National Laboratory
